# Voprosy Metodologii

> A digital archive of the Russian methodological journal Voprosy Metodologii (1991–1999): 15 issues, 2,274 scanned pages, OCR texts and Markdown tables of contents.

## About

Archive of the journal founded by G. P. Shchedrovitsky, published by the Moscow Methodological Circle (MMK). Covers activity theory, SMD-methodology, pedagogy, organizational-activity games (ODI), systems approach and hermeneutics. Spanning 1991–1999 (1993 is missing).

- Author: [Maxim Osovsky](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q107189449)
- URL: https://github.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0
